name: start_build_computer
description: Start a local agentenv computer to build a desktop app environment on, and return its id with a first screenshot as an image. From a request, REA renders a bundle that installs the app from the Ubuntu archive, an apt repository or a .deb URL, opens it on demand from its desktop entry (it is not open at first: open it from the desktop's Applications menu, under Other, by the environment's name), and installs REA itself in a build-only layer from REA_BUILD_COMPUTER_REA_ARCHIVE. Set source.electron for an Electron app: the install rewrites that desktop entry's command with the same launch policy an export uses, adding --no-sandbox right after the program unless the command already has it, because the container does not grant the user namespaces Chromium needs and Electron exits without the flag. From a bundle folder, such as an exported one, it starts that bundle's smoke task as it is. Needs Docker and the agentenv runner named by REA_AGENT_ENV_COMMAND; the first start of a bundle builds its image, which downloads packages and can take minutes. screenshot sets the first screenshot's region, format and quality. The computer stays up, reachable on this host, until close_build_computer or the server closes; when a start fails before its teardown is confirmed, the error's computer_id names what close_build_computer retries.
